finalText:
Redis went down and took the service with it.

02:14:07 Redis refused connections at 10.0.0.12:6379. Cache fell back to store reads.
Store overloaded. Timeouts hit 5000ms. Queue depth climbed 52 to 568. Max was 500.
All 12 reconnect attempts failed.
02:31:44 worker-2 died of heap exhaustion. 02:31:52 supervisor killed api.

Log is dated 2026-07-04, not last night.
